assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached portrait isometric game arena chaos_vert_toxique. Remove ONLY the thin artificial bright WHITE tactical diamond grid overlay drawn across the floor. Restore the original natural floor texture beneath those white lines. Preserve the natural dark paving seams, cracks, magical gold/green ornament or central grate, ice/snow/moss/lava details. Keep camera angle, exact framing and floor boundaries, ALL architecture, stairs, props, colors, light and shadows IDENTICAL to the original. This image will be toggled against the original in a game: no crop, no zoom, no rearrangement, no redesign. Keep portrait 9:16 aspect ratio. Remove all white straight tactical grid lines including near floor edges. Do not remove real floor seams or thematic ornament. No text or UI. Return exactly one clean background.
assets.normalization: ImageMagick resize to original 540x960 canvas; no crop
